description: This file contains implementation of version parsing and comparison functions for Go toolchain versions, including a 'gover' struct, comparison logic, and version validation.

classes.name: gover
classes.description: Struct representing a parsed Go version with major, minor, patch, kind, and pre fields.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two version strings, returning -1, 0, or 1 based on their order.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Returns the Go language version (e.g., '1.2') from a version string.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a version string is valid.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a version string into a 'gover' struct, returning zero value if malformed.
